title: Send email with Tinysend
description: Send transactional email from a Tinysend mailbox on tinysend.com or your own domain, with an idempotency key so a retry sends once.

environment.name: TINYSEND_API_KEY
environment.description: API key (sk_...) from app.tinysend.com/account/tokens. Keep it server-side.

environment.name: TINYSEND_FROM
environment.description: Default sender: one of your Tinysend mailboxes, for example hello@yourdomain.com. A request can name another mailbox in from.

environment.name: TINYSEND_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: POST to, subject, and text or html; optionally from, reply_to, tag and metadata. An Idempotency-Key header makes a retry return the first send.
